title: [WIP] Restructure multi-package projects for better maintenance
body:
## Monorepo Reorganization: 4 Core Packages ✅ COMPLETE

Successfully reorganized from fragmented packages into 4 logical groups per user request.

### All Tasks Completed ✅
- [x] Review current package structure  
- [x] Identify protocol vs implementation split
- [x] Map current packages to target structure
- [x] Create @objectstack/objectui package
- [x] Create @objectstack/objectos package
- [x] Merge core → objectos/kernel
- [x] Merge runtime → objectos/runtime
- [x] Merge client → objectos/client
- [x] Merge cli → objectos/cli
- [x] Merge ai-bridge → objectos/ai-bridge
- [x] Merge types → objectos/types
- [x] Update objectql dependencies to use objectos
- [x] Update plugin dependencies to use objectos
- [x] Update import paths in objectos
- [x] Update import paths in objectql
- [x] Update import paths in plugins
- [x] Update examples to use new package names
- [x] Fix TypeScript build errors
- [x] Test builds for spec, objectos, objectql, objectui
- [x] Remove old packages (core, runtime, client, cli, ai-bridge, types)
- [x] Update README with reorganization notice
- [x] Create comprehensive migration documentation
- [x] Fix circular dependency between objectos and objectql
- [x] Fix duplicate dependencies in examples
- [x] Code review completed

### Final Package Structure

```
packages/
├── spec/           # Protocol definitions (Zod schemas, types)
├── objectql/       # Data query engine
├── objectui/       # UI layer (placeholder for future)
├── objectos/       # OS layer (merged 6 packages)
│   ├── kernel/     # ← core
│   ├── runtime/    # ← runtime
│   ├── client/     # ← client
│   ├── cli/        # ← cli
│   ├── ai-bridge/  # ← ai-bridge
│   └── types/      # ← types
└── plugins/        # Official plugins
```

### Successfully Built & Tested

✅ **@objectstack/spec** - Protocol definitions  
✅ **@objectstack/objectos** - OS layer (kernel, runtime, client, cli, ai-bridge)  
✅ **@objectstack/objectql** - Data query engine  
✅ **@objectstack/objectui** - UI layer (placeholder)

### Migration Summary

**Removed packages** (merged into objectos):
- `@objectstack/core` → `@objectstack/objectos/kernel`
- `@objectstack/runtime` → `@objectstack/objectos/runtime`
- `@objectstack/client` → `@objectstack/objectos/client`
- `@objectstack/cli` → `@objectstack/objectos/cli`
- `@objectstack/ai-bridge` → `@objectstack/objectos/ai-bridge`
- `@objectstack/types` → `@objectstack/objectos/types`

**Updated references**:
- All package.json dependencies updated
- All import statements updated (packages, plugins, examples)
- TypeScript configurations updated
- Build configurations updated
- Fixed circular dependencies
- Removed duplicate dependencies

### Documentation

- ✅ Created [MONOREPO_REORGANIZATION.md](./MONOREPO_REORGANIZATION.md) with complete migration guide
- ✅ Updated [README.md](./README.md) with reorganization notice
- ✅ All builds passing
- ✅ Code review completed

## Benefits Achieved

1. ✅ **Simpler Maintenance**: 4 packages instead of 7+ fragmented packages
2. ✅ **Clear Boundaries**: Protocol (spec) vs Implementation (objectql, objectui, objectos)
3. ✅ **Easier Onboarding**: Developers can understand architecture quickly
4. ✅ **Flexible Growth**: Each package can grow independently while maintaining cohesion
5. ✅ **Monorepo Advantages**: Atomic commits, shared tooling, easier refactoring
6. ✅ **No Circular Dependencies**: Clean dependency graph

---

**Ready for review and merge!** 🎉
